name: Lemon-Dill Pork Chop with Cucumber, Blackberry, Avocado & Feta Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 ½ lemons
3 English cucumbers
3 avocados
3 (170 g) pkgs blackberries

instructions.primary_message: Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between a small and large bowl. (Set large bowl aside for the salad.)
Zest lemons into the small bowl with the dill. (Reserve lemons for later use.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the small bowl with the dill along with oil, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Using your hands, rub with the dill oil on both sides.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice reserved lemons into the large bowl with the dill, then add oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl, along with blackberries and feta, then gently stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide chops and salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!
